title: Correction Entries for Replaced, Programmed, and Ordered Parts
summary: The fragments are service correction notes describing actions such as replacing and programming components, checking hood alignment, and ordering parts, but they provide too little context to determine customer sentiment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mainly record repair actions like replacing and programming a TCB or charging tray, checking hood alignment, and noting a part on order without enough context to judge sentiment.

limitations: All sampled fragments are undetermined service-note snippets rather than full customer opinions, so sentiment cannot be reliably assessed.
Several examples contain only the word 'Correction:' and provide insufficient detail about the issue, outcome, or customer reaction.

The topic mixes different service actions and components, including TCB programming, charging tray or pad replacement, hood alignment, and parts ordering, so the cluster is not a single coherent issue.
